changelog:
- Initial release of AI Website & Lead-follow-up Auditor.
- Audits service business websites for missed lead capture and automation opportunities.
- Provides checklist covering CTAs, forms, chat features, booking, trust signals, and automation integrations.
- Output includes overall score, identified problems, prioritized recommendations, and outreach summary.
summary: Analyze any service business website to identify missed leads, weak follow-up, chatbot gaps, and AI automation opportunities, then generate a prioritized audit with actionable recommendations to improve conversions.
